cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Keep Hope Operational
cards.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your cloud rained the letter M onto the lawn. I've approved your plan to make it write 'Marry me' tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It collapsed after one letter. Can we check the full-length test report?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're permitted to start with what worked. Photograph that M; I'll hold the report while you mark out the next letter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've turned the report face down. What does it say about keeping the cloud alive?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll keep that for later. Your M is real. Set the proposal table beside it; let her see the first word beginning while we prepare the rest.

reason: Define an impossible writing cloud and the desired proposal, use an explicit collapse as the discouraging limit, and make A withhold further results while directing evidence and table placement.
